description: KNaHf₄(PO₄)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. K is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.67 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.60 Å. There are two inequivalent Hf sites. In the first Hf site, Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.09 Å) Hf-O bond lengths. In the second Hf site, Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.08 Å) Hf-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-35°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Hf, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one P atom.
